# sprint milestones get

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../milestones.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint milestones get — Read permitted records

SYNOPSIS
  sprint milestones get ID_OR_EXACT_NAME --project PROJECT_ID [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Read permitted records

EXAMPLES
  sprint milestones get ID_OR_EXACT_NAME --project PROJECT_ID

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  ID_OR_EXACT_NAME

FLAGS
  --project ID (required; see SYNOPSIS)

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  Milestones are native project-owned records, not sprints or subgoals. Reads require exactly one nonempty --project PROJECT_ID. List accepts only --project, --query, --sort name|-name, --page and --limit. Get accepts ID_OR_EXACT_NAME and --project only; selector is one encoded URL segment supporting names up to 500 UTF-16 code units, including Unicode and slashes; ambiguous exact names fail HTTP 409. Create fields are exactly {name,projectId}; update is a nonempty partial {name,projectId?}; name is trimmed, nonblank native text up to 500 UTF-16 code units, with no control characters; reserved names '.' and '..' are rejected. Server generates IDs and attribution; update/delete require native IDs, never name selectors. Project moves are rejected. No sprint, status, scheduling or issue association. Server validates payloads; no default project or retries.

SEE ALSO
  sprint help milestones
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/milestones/get.md
```
